# M1-14 — PED v1.0 Integration, Team Review & Baseline Sign-off

## Labels
`docs`, `milestone-1`, `priority-critical`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Integrate all M1 sections (M1-01 through M1-13 outputs) into one coherent PED v1.0
- [ ] Apply consistent section numbering, identifiers and formatting per the PED Quality Standard
- [ ] Add version history: authorship, review and approval information
- [ ] Conduct a full team review of PED v1.0 before sign-off
- [ ] Complete the Baseline Sign-off template (Appendix D of the Master Project Brief)
- [ ] Record the gate outcome (ACCEPTED / CONDITIONALLY ACCEPTED / REVISION REQUIRED) once assessed
- [ ] Tag/release the baselined version in the repository (e.g. git tag `ped-v1.0`)

## Acceptance Criteria
- PED v1.0 is a single coherent document, not a bundle of unrelated fragments.
- Version history clearly shows who wrote/reviewed/approved each part.
- Baseline sign-off template is fully completed with a recorded outcome.
- A git tag or release marks the exact baselined commit for future reference.
